plugin.note: Bronze dragon strategy: weak to stab, heavy ranged, and Earth spells; dragonbane weapons are best. Bronze dragons do not drop the draconic visage, so use them mainly for fast cannon tasks.

requirements: Partial completion of Dragon Slayer I
Full dragonfire protection from anti-dragon shield plus antifire, or super antifire
Use Brimhaven task-only area for speed
mechanics: Metallic dragonfire is not blocked by Protect from Magic.
Bronze dragons use melee and long-range dragonfire.
Without complete dragonfire protection, stay in melee range and use Protect from Melee.
Bronze dragons have a 50% earth spell vulnerability and the draconic attribute.

methods.label: Dragonfire protection
methods.summary: Use full metallic dragonfire protection before fighting Bronze dragons.
requiredOrKeyItems: Antifire potion or super antifire potion
Protect from Melee if in melee range
steps: Use anti-dragon shield plus antifire for complete protection, or use super antifire without a shield.
Do not rely on Protect from Magic because metallic dragonfire ignores it.
If protection is incomplete, stay in melee range and use Protect from Melee to reduce dragonfire frequency.

methods.label: Fast Brimhaven cannon
methods.summary: Use the Brimhaven task-only area for the fastest low-level Metal dragon task.
steps: Use the task-only Brimhaven Dungeon area with five Bronze dragons.
Use dragonbane, stab, heavy ranged, or earth spell gear.
notes: Bronze dragons are the weakest Metal dragon option but do not drop the draconic visage.

styleOptions.label: Melee dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Stab-focused melee with dragon hunter lance or high-accuracy stab weapons.

styleOptions.label: Ranged dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Heavy ranged or dragon hunter crossbow setup.

styleOptions.label: Earth Magic
styleOptions.summary: Earth spell or dragon hunter wand setup using the 50% earth weakness.

body:
# Bronze dragon

Weak to stab, heavy ranged, and Earth spells; very high Defence. Dragon hunter lance is best stab versus draconic creatures, then fang. Do not use slash.
